name: vyavastha
description: Checks each request against what your team has said and decided before Codex changes code, answers your questions about your team from its record, and tells teammates which files are changing.

interface.shortDescription: Checks each request against what your team has decided.
interface.longDescription: Before Codex changes code, your request is checked against what your team has said and decided. When something stands in the way, the request is held and you are told who said what. After files change, teammates see which ones.
